Where a patch meets the background, the two materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the edge of every patch is made only of the patch's material and the background material, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
